description: How Gene learns in the workspace: for each source (conversations, project questions, files, the site, project work, corrections, connected services) whether Gene keeps what it learns On its own, Ask first or Off, for everyone and as the person set it for themselves, and what applies to them; whether learning is paused (for everyone, for them); how often prices and opening hours are checked (checkSchedule, null for never); and keeping it fresh (forget short-lived things when they pass, when to ask about things nobody uses, the morning summary). canSetForEveryone says whether the person is an owner or admin.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.
